meta.description: Daily city-level ridership matched with FMI historical weather observations (2024-2025)
meta.season_coverage: 214 days in 2024 (Apr 1 - Oct 31), 214 days in 2025 (Apr 1 - Oct 31)
methodological_guardrails: Weather features represent retrospective FMI ground observations, strictly NOT weather forecasts.
Correlation with ridership (+0.74 temp, -0.25 rain) is descriptive seasonal co-movement, NOT causality.
Weather features were strictly excluded from predictive model feature matrices.
